title: ChatInteractContext
description: Typed request context captured by the UI when creating a chat interaction. This is runtime metadata, not user-visible message text.

activeArtifact.description: Artifact viewer state that was active when the user submitted the message.

visibilitySession.description: Active contextual workbench session captured when the user submitted the message.

clientRequestId.description: Optional UI-generated id for deduplicating client retries.

surface.description: UI shell that submitted the chat interaction when the request was created.
